tests.result: Ran 64 tests; OK; 새 회귀 2개 포함

result_tail: PASS: lightweight startup, deferred explanations, shared downloads, retry/storage, SRI including stale-app rejection, startup retry; file:// unit passed (real browser blocked)

PASS: keyboard groups/modal replacement/bookmark return focus; persistent grade-once and debounced result live regions; preview hides review notes until the answer is opened, xl text in modals/pick reasons, no concept overflow at xl, live bookmark subject counts, stale cross-tab finish dialog, resume position after removed ids, malformed hash, unreadable/newer record preservation and download, re-render keeps details/focus/caret, table arrow keys, bookmark focus, quota pruning

PASS: first review of pre-existing records promotes, due-later-today promotes, derived schedule without writes, due-ordered review session, Leitner box moves, next-date tile, backup/restore with and without schedule, unreadable schedule preserved, cross-tab update, unchanged study schema

PASS: part/count/review filters, grading, reload/resume, incomplete finish, wrong replay, bookmarks, search, multi-answer, quarantine, export/import, history, keyboard, desktop/mobile/text/zoom, concept notes (index/pending/related/part study/quiz-wrong-preview links/tax-year highlight/state kept), choice blocks, arrow keys, next steps, grouped chapters, theme toggle; no browser errors
PASS: load, images, search, multiple-answer scoring, variants, quarantine, comparison, part filters, subject reset, tag search, classification review filter, mobile layout; no browser errors.

PASS: all 4281 explanation bodies rendered; 225 grading flows (original 30 + new part/concept/calculation coverage), 26 enriched concept pages and new examples, 12 revised opinion previews and 4 official-key grading/reload checks, no pre-grade reveal, 4 options, review status/year, reload, wrong notebook, related concepts, unchanged records, independent variants, pending content, mobile, explanation-only practice, chosen-option reasons first, joined choice wraps, quiz bottom bar; no browser errors
PASS: failed different-build update preserves the previous manifest, all three deferred subjects, and offline readiness.
PASS: an open tab on the previous build announces the saved newer version rather than a failure.
PASS: a failed bank load still offers the unchanged study record for download.

limits: 브라우저 검사는 로컬 Chromium이며 공개 HTTPS 실브라우저를 새로 확인하지 않았습니다.
실제 file:// 브라우저 탐색은 환경 정책으로 차단되어 기존 검사에서 SKIP했습니다. file-loader 단위 분기는 통과했습니다.
이전 작성자와 다른 현재 주 담당자의 출처 대조이며 이번에 새 독립 하위 에이전트·전문가 검수는 실행하지 않았습니다.
부분 확인 115개·미등록 40개·부분 개념 8개는 완료로 처리하지 않았습니다.
